status.en: 15 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 25% more than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Erbil.
status.nb: 15 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 25 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Erbil.

summary.en: Iranian drones have struck Kurdish opposition camps and the Komala headquarters in northern Iraq, while Israeli forces have hit weapons depots and air-defence warehouses inside the country, prompting Baghdad to accuse Israel and probe the closure of Iran border crossings amid protests. Iraq and the United States are discussing expanding their military partnership and joint security coordination, and Iraq’s foreign minister has spoken about increasing Iraq’s participation in UN peacekeeping operations. The conflict produced 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Iranske droner har rammet kurdiske opposisjonsleirer og Komala-hovedkvarteret i Nord-Irak, mens israelske styrker har truffet våpenlagre og luftvernsdepot i landet, noe som får Bagdad til å anklage Israel og undersøke stengingen av Irans grenseoverganger midt i protester. Irak og USA diskuterer å utvide sitt militære partnerskap og felles sikkerhetskoordinering, og Iraks utenriksminister har snakket om å øke Iraks deltakelse i FN-fredsbevarende operasjoner. Konflikten førte til 396 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
